title: Delta snapshots
description:
Send only what changed since a snapshot the client already has.

```
baseline: {1: (10, 5, 100hp), 2: (3, 3, 80hp)}
current:  {1: (11, 5, 100hp), 3: (0, 0, 50hp)}
delta: changed 1 (x only), removed 2, added 3
applied to baseline -> equals current: true
```
hints: For each entity in `current`: new if not in `baseline`, otherwise compare each field and set a bit (1 = x, 2 = y, 4 = hp) (lesson 6.02).
Removed ids are in `baseline` but not in `current`.
requirements: Entities are `(id -> {x, y, hp})` in a `std::map`.
The delta lists changed fields per entity (a bit mask), removed ids and new entities.
`apply(baseline, delta)` gives back exactly the current snapshot.
stretch: Count the bytes each would take on the wire and compare a full snapshot with the delta.
